name: chibako
description: Self-hosted second brain for AI agents: token-budgeted recall, Markdown notes, wikilinks, and backlinks.

interface.shortDescription: Token-efficient second brain for AI agents
interface.longDescription: Chibako is a self-hosted, Obsidian-like knowledge box. This plugin bundles the Chibako Memory skill and connects to the Chibako MCP server so an agent can recall relevant notes within a token budget, read and write Markdown notes, and maintain [[wikilinks]] and backlinks without loading the whole vault into context.
defaultPrompt: Use Chibako to recall our prior decisions before you start.
Use $chibako-memory to load relevant vault context for this task.
